name: Shree Ganesh Remedies Limited
summary: Shree Ganesh Remedies Ltd. operates within the healthcare industry, specializing in the entire process of conceiving, developing, producing, and distributing medical goods. Their portfolio features a variety of items such as pharmaceutical intermediates, finished drugs, animal health products, and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). The company, which was established on April 27, 1995, has its corporate headquarters in Ankleshwar, India.
